LanguageData.FB_ForcedFleshConversion_Desc: Pick a prisoner, a downed hostile or one of your free colonists. Roots pin the target in stasis under anesthetic right where it is, and the nearest fingerspikes come and implant themselves into it: one is required for every 300 market value, half as many for your own colonists. Unrecruitable targets are remade as toughspikes.

LanguageData.FB_ForcedFleshConversion_Success: {0} has been accepted by the flesh colony.

LanguageData.FB_ForcedFleshConversion_HumanlikeOnly: Only living humanlike pawns can be accepted by force.
LanguageData.FB_ForcedFleshConversion_NotColonists: Of your own people, only free colonists can accept the flesh.
LanguageData.FB_ForcedFleshConversion_TargetStatus: Target must be a prisoner or a downed hostile pawn.
